text: I think you'll really enjoy this Memphis Style Coleslaw recipe! Given your history of liking recipes that feature Worcestershire sauce, I'm guessing you'll appreciate the optional addition of it to this slaw. Additionally, the ingredients and preparation time are relatively simple, which might appeal to you since your liked recipes tend to take about 45 minutes to make. The fact that it's ready in just 8 minutes is also a bonus, and the flavors seem to be a good balance of sweet, tangy, and savory.
